title: A more welcoming first run
lede: Calm native surfaces, clear account and profile steps, and restrained motion that keeps the next action in reach.

stats.n: 3 simulator interaction tests and 20 source-contract tests.
Stable controls with a short directional page transition.

sections.heading: Matched before and after
sections.note: Same fixture, device, appearance, text size and initial scroll. Baseline is the preceding usability pass. The keyboard now stays closed on arrival; this intentional behavior change accounts for its difference between captures.

sections.heading: Larger text
sections.note: After-only Accessibility Large captures. Forms scroll and primary actions remain available.

changes.was: Dense form presentation and competing labels.
changes.now: One centered system title, a soft symbol tile, and a short explanation.

changes.was: Compact form controls and a utilitarian action area.
changes.now: Inset fields, generous spacing, and a rounded action above a system material footer.

changes.was: Abrupt step changes and automatic keyboard presentation.
changes.now: Directional page transitions with stable controls; the keyboard opens when a field is selected.

verification: Final Xcode simulator build and all 3 onboarding interaction tests passed.
Native drift, documentation verification, and diff whitespace checks passed.
Light, dark, larger-text screenshots and recorded forward/Back transition frames inspected.
notes: Local, uncommitted work. No real account or profile was changed.
Reduce Motion fallback is implemented; runtime VoiceOver and Reduce Motion acceptance remain unverified.
